_about: Path-B (buyable-part) eval for the eBay resolver. Live-marketplace evals churn, so assertions are split: INVARIANTS must hold on every run forever (a fail is a regression); SNAPSHOTS are dated observations expected to drift (informational only — the runner never fails on them). Run: `node scripts/eval-vision-resolver.js` (needs EVAL_TOKEN set to match the server env; hits the founder/eval-gated /api/vision/ebay-health).

cases.name: rotor-srt392-trim-filter
cases.query: 2015 Dodge Challenger SRT 392 front brake rotor

snapshot_2026_07_07.note: The dangerous regression: BEFORE the trim filter a $232 'Front Rear Drilled Rotors for Challenger Charger Magnum Chrysler 300' generic multi-platform set surfaced for an SRT 392 (which runs 390mm Brembos). Trim filter must keep that out. verifiedPartNumber legitimately null here — rotors are multi-brand.

A number CAN verify (3 sellers), but wiper fitment is by SIZE and listings disagreed (22+22 vs 21+21). The VERIFIED badge means the number is real, NOT that the size fits — spec carries fitment. PN + counts are snapshots, expected to drift.
